note: Ps116 personal thanksgiving (19v). Read by CHAR-ARC. A LOVE+CALL born of God's hearing (LOVE, PLEAS-FOR-MERCY, CALL) v1-2; B distress->cry (SUFFERED/ANGUISH, CALLED, PRAY, deliver SOUL) v3-4; C grace->rest (SIMPLE, BROUGHT-LOW, RETURN O my SOUL to rest) v5-7; D deliverance+faith amid affliction (SOUL from death, TEARS, WALK before the LORD, BELIEVED, AFFLICTED, ALARM, LIARS) v8-11; E grateful response (RENDER, LIFT-UP the cup, CALL, PAY vows, SAINTS, THANKSGIVING, CALL, PAY, PRAISE) v12-19. God's heard/inclined/gracious/preserves/saved/delivered/loosed = qualifiers; snares/Sheol/cup/vows imagery = standalone.

dims.v: paired with God hearing his pleas
v1: 'I LOVE (aheb) the LORD, because he has heard my voice and my pleas for mercy' - the love that answers answered prayer, devotion born of God's hearing.
paired with the love and calling
v1: 'he has heard my voice and my PLEAS FOR MERCY (tachanun)' - the supplications God heard, the cry that drew forth love.
God as long as he lives
paired with God inclining his ear
v2: 'therefore I will CALL (qara) on him as long as I live' - the lifelong resolve to pray, gratitude become habit.
v3: 'I SUFFERED (matsa) distress and anguish' - the depth of the psalmist's trouble, the low point before the cry.
v3: 'I suffered distress and ANGUISH (yagon)' - the grief of the sufferer, snared by death and Sheol.
on the name of the LORD
paired with the plea to deliver his soul
v4: 'Then I CALLED (qara) on the name of the LORD' - the cry from the depths, the turn from anguish to God.
v4: 'O LORD, I PRAY (anna), deliver my soul!' - the urgent plea, the naked cry for rescue.
paired with the plea to deliver
v4: 'O LORD, I pray, deliver my SOUL (nephesh)!' - the self begging rescue, life pleading for its life.
paired with being brought low and saved
v6: 'The LORD preserves the SIMPLE (pethi)' - the artless, the childlike, whom God keeps; the psalmist owns himself among them.
v6: 'when I was BROUGHT LOW (dalal), he saved me' - the abasement from which God rescued, low estate met by salvation.
paired with the soul at rest
v7: 'RETURN (shuv), O my soul, to your rest' - the self-summons to peace, the soul called home to quiet after deliverance.
v7: 'Return, O my SOUL (nephesh), to your rest' - the inmost self addressed, bidden to settle in God's bounty.
paired with eyes from tears, feet from stumbling
v8: 'For you have delivered my SOUL (nephesh) from death' - the self rescued from the grave, the ground of the rest.
v8: 'my eyes from TEARS (dimah)' - the weeping God turned back, grief dried by deliverance.
before the LORD in the land of the living
v9: 'I will WALK (halak) before the LORD in the land of the living' - the life of faith resumed, conduct lived out in God's presence.
v10: 'I BELIEVED (aman), even when I spoke: I am greatly afflicted' - the faith that held even under affliction, belief speaking through pain.
v10: 'I am greatly AFFLICTED (anah)' - the depth of the suffering the psalmist confessed even as he believed.
paired with judging all men liars
v11: 'I said in my ALARM (chaphaz), All mankind are liars' - the panic of the sufferer, dismay that trusted no man.
v11: 'All mankind are LIARS (kazab)' - the verdict of the alarmed, human faithlessness weighed against God's truth.
to the LORD for his benefits
paired with lifting the cup of salvation
v12: 'What shall I RENDER (shuv) to the LORD for all his benefits to me?' - the grateful question, the search for a fitting response.
paired with calling on God's name
v13: 'I will LIFT UP (nasa) the cup of salvation' - the thankful gesture, raising the cup in acknowledgement of God's rescue.
on the name of the LORD
v13: 'and CALL (qara) on the name of the LORD' - worship joined to the cup, prayer with thanksgiving.
paired with the presence of all his people
v14: 'I will PAY (shalam) my vows to the LORD in the presence of all his people' - the vows fulfilled, gratitude made public.
paired with the preciousness of their death
v15: 'Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his SAINTS (chasid)' - the godly, whose very death God holds dear.
paired with calling on God's name
v17: 'I will offer to you the sacrifice of THANKSGIVING (todah)' - the thank-offering of the delivered, gratitude enacted.
on the name of the LORD
v17: 'and CALL (qara) on the name of the LORD' - worship joined to the sacrifice.
paired with the presence of all his people
v18: 'I will PAY (shalam) my vows to the LORD in the presence of all his people' - the vows fulfilled before the assembly.
v19: 'PRAISE (halal) the LORD!' - the closing Hallelujah, the psalm sealed with praise.
